key_points: CF Industries fell 6.1% after Trump floated a plan to import cheaper potash from Belarus, undercutting Canadian supply — confirmed by WSJ, Barron's, and Yahoo Finance.
The Belarus potash deal is still nascent and faces significant sanctions/logistics hurdles (Belaruskali has historically been sanctioned), so full materialization is uncertain.
CF Industries is primarily a nitrogen fertilizer producer, so its direct potash exposure is limited; the sell-off may partly reflect sector-wide sentiment overreaction.
Near-term bearish pressure on fertilizer stocks is likely to persist as the market prices in potential potash supply increases and margin compression.
Over weeks, the direction depends on whether the Belarus deal progresses to a signed agreement or stalls on regulatory/political obstacles — resolution could reverse the negative move.
